## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its reason.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Tests and documentation cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated rather than edited manually.
- [ ] Errors, logs, and user-facing output are in English.
- [ ] No secrets, private addresses, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive findings were reported through `SECURITY.md` instead.
